newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico Nobel poet laureate Paz has health check.
newsitem.headline: Mexico Nobel poet laureate Paz has health check.

text.p: Mexico's Nobel poet laureate Octavio Paz checked into Mexico City's National Nutrition Institute on Monday for health checks, government news agency Notimex said.
Paz, 82, was undergoing routine tests and was not in ill health, although he was depressed following a fire at his home in December, Notimex quoted sources close to the poet as saying.

Paz escaped unharmed from a Dec. 23 blaze that damaged his apartment in Mexico City and destroyed a precious collection of books and artefacts. The fire was caused by a short-circuit in a television set.
Paz, who won the Nobel prize for literature in 1990, suffers from phlebitis, which causes blood circulation problems and restricts his mobility.
